note: The street trees and the park trees (plan 0005, R12a). tools/geo/build.py puts them along the roads and in the parks and writes data/geo/build/trees.json. The trees on the hills come from the surface mask in the game. A mix gives the share of each tree type. The game shows each type in the season of the game date. Tree types: shade (large shade trees), tall_shade (tall trees between the Bãi Trước road and the sea), flame (phượng vĩ), frangipani (hoa sứ), casuarina (phi lao), coconut, fan_palm. The mixes and the spacings are builder values from photos: check.

bai_truoc_road.comment: The road along Bãi Trước is the coast road that the homestay search finds (homestay.json). Its trees stand between the road and the sea.

osm_trees.comment: OSM natural=tree nodes and natural=tree_row ways. A tag genus or species can select the type.
